voice.prosody:
Welcome to ROADGUARD AI
the next-generation smart-city platform for road damage intelligence and municipal maintenance triage.
Every year, billions of dollars are lost to road decay.
Traditional inspections are slow, paper-bound, and leave hazardous potholes unattended.
ROADGUARD AI transforms this into an automated, four-step intelligence pipeline:
capture, detect, prioritize, and dispatch.
Powered by Ultralytics YOLO, our computer vision engine scans road imagery in real time,
localizing potholes and structural fissures with high-confidence bounding box overlays and surface area metrics.
Our explainable scoring engine calculates an objective 0 to 100 visual hazard index
factoring in damaged surface area, defect cluster density, and roadway traffic context.
Every incident is mapped on an interactive GIS telemetry system with priority-coded markers, cluster analysis, and embedded photographic evidence.
Municipal authorities manage a live, ranked maintenance queue, audit repair lifecycles, and generate official civil engineering PDF work orders with a single click.
ROADGUARD AI:
Building safer, smarter, data-driven municipal infrastructure.
